name: Guided Workflow
summary: Step-by-step dunnage receiving workflow covering mode selection, a hosted image-backed part search step that hands off into standard part selection, type and part selection, Receiving-style load-count entry, per-load quantity entry, details entry with selected-part home-location prefilling plus editable Infor Visual location validation, fallback to the configured Dunnage user default only when the selected part has no saved home location, final review with a save-complete decision dialog, configured part inventory-method propagation, add/edit part dialogs that can reuse saved spec templates and capture definition-based part-specific runtime specs for newly created parts, PNG-backed type and part imagery shown in selection, manual entry, and review surfaces, Receiving-style per-part skid counters written to the Dunnage queue and history archive, a responsive 3x3 type card selector that shows either the uploaded image or the icon while always keeping the type name visible, weak-event workflow notifications, and module-scoped unsaved state.

workflowAreas: Infor Visual location validation with fuzzy-match recovery
Unsaved state survives only inside the current module
uiElements: Configured inventory method indicator on the part details card
userActions: Identify a part from its configured image and continue into guided entry with that part selected
Recognize dunnage types and parts from uploaded PNG imagery when available
Set the number of loads and quantity for each load
Reuse saved spec templates when quick-adding or editing a part from Part Selection
Capture extra definition-based part-specific runtime specs when the configured type specs are not enough
Generate Dunnage queue rows that retain a per-part skid sequence and total for label printing
See the review PO normalized to the canonical Receiving format with vendor feedback when available
Start from the selected part's saved home location when one exists, or the configured Dunnage user default when it does not
Keep an intentionally typed Dunnage location all the way through save instead of resetting to a saved default
Recover from mistyped Dunnage locations via fuzzy selection
Lose unsaved work when leaving the module or exiting before save
validationHints: Confirm the Dunnage details step prefills the selected part's saved home location when the session location is blank
Confirm the Dunnage details step falls back to the configured Dunnage user default only when the selected part has no saved home location
Confirm invalid Dunnage locations are validated against Infor Visual warehouse 002 and offer fuzzy suggestions before Review
Confirm typing a Dunnage location updates the viewmodel immediately and does not revert to the part or user default when the user tabs away
Confirm Review and Save use the current location textbox value instead of re-reading the selected part's saved home location
Confirm the guided workflow still advances correctly between steps
Confirm the hosted image-search step opens inside the workflow content area and clicking a part card carries the selected type and part into the standard Part Selection step
Confirm uploaded type images appear on type cards and selected-type headers when present
Confirm uploaded part images appear in part selection and review when present
Confirm the type-selection step advances by card click without a separate Next button
Confirm the mode-selection step exposes the same clear-label action available elsewhere in the guided flow
Confirm the part details card includes the selected part's saved configured values and any active runtime specs derived from part-specific definitions
Confirm Quick Add Part and Edit Part can reopen with a selected existing spec template applied
Confirm Quick Add Part and Edit Part retain any added part-specific spec definitions after reopening from the existing-spec picker
Confirm the part-selection step no longer shows a separate inventory warning banner above the part details card
Confirm inventoried parts carry their configured inventory method into Details Entry and Review instead of always showing Receive In
Confirm Dunnage saves assign each row a part_skid_sequence and part_skid_total based on the number of loads saved for the same part in the batch
Confirm changing the number of loads rebuilds the per-load quantity editors without losing values that still apply
Confirm guided-step collections and spec groups still repopulate correctly after whole-collection replacement
Confirm Enter Loads no longer shows the Selection Summary card above the quantity editor
Confirm each generated load reaches Review with the correct load number and quantity

Confirm Enter Details merges configured part values with any part-specific runtime spec definitions and pushes the resulting dynamic spec values into each generated load before save so specs_json is written to dunnage_label_data and dunnage_history
Confirm Enter Details proceeds directly to Review when validation passes, without an extra confirmation modal
Confirm Review exposes a Back path to Enter Details and shows a completion dialog offering Start New Entry or Mode Selection after save

Confirm the dunnage type selector shows 9 cards per page in a 3x3 layout, hides the icon when a type image is present, keeps the type name visible, and scales cleanly within the card area when the window is resized
Confirm manual entry, details entry, and review all show the active runtime spec set, including values seeded from part-specific definitions on newly created parts
Confirm Dunnage review normalizes PO values such as 62450 or PO-62450 to PO-062450 before display
Confirm Dunnage review shows the vendor name when a valid PO exists in Infor Visual or mock mode
Confirm Dunnage review shows an inline vendor-area not-found message when the PO format is valid but the PO does not exist
Confirm the vendor area stays hidden when the Dunnage PO is blank, free-form non-PO text, or otherwise malformed
Confirm step-based UI refresh still works after revisiting dunnage views without retaining stale subscribers
Confirm leaving Dunnage before save clears unsaved workflow data

summary: Guided Dunnage workflow that walks the user through mode selection, type selection, part selection, quantity entry, details entry, and review. The flow now treats archived-part history as the source for saved spec groups and default values, keeps review and label state synchronized after edit/delete actions, blocks quick-add for archived-only parts, and enforces location selection before save in guided and manual entry. Guided and manual saves now archive active labels before a type change, preserve manual rows through Save to History, allow the user to archive and clear the active queue from the workflow shell, disable Dunnage navigation while saves are running, prompt before leaving the module or changing mode with unsaved work, and fully reset visible input state when starting over.
